tickets.title: [{SOURCE}] Source Discovery - Requirements Gathering & SME Identification
tickets.description:
As a Data Analyst, I need to gather comprehensive source requirements and identify Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to ensure successful data integration from {SOURCE}.

## Overview
This ticket covers the initial discovery phase for {SOURCE} integration, including requirements gathering, SME identification, and source catalog documentation.

## Scope
- **Requirements Gathering**: Document all data requirements, business rules, and data quality expectations
- **SME Identification**: Identify and engage with source system SMEs and business stakeholders
- **Source Catalog**: Complete the source catalog with detailed metadata information

## Technical Details
- Source System: {SOURCE}
- Target Environment: {ENV}
- Integration Pattern: Batch/Streaming (TBD based on requirements)
acceptance_criteria: All source system requirements are documented and approved by stakeholders
SMEs are identified and contact information is recorded in the project documentation
Source system data dictionary is obtained and reviewed
Data volume, velocity, and variety characteristics are documented
Source catalog entry is complete with all required fields populated
Business rules and data transformation requirements are documented
Data quality requirements and SLAs are defined and agreed upon
Security and compliance requirements are identified

tickets.title: [{SOURCE}] Source Discovery - Ingestion Design & Analysis

## Overview

## Scope
- **Ingestion Design**: Define the technical approach for data ingestion
- **Data Profiling**: Analyze source data structure, quality, and patterns
- **Architecture Documentation**: Document the proposed ingestion architecture

## Technical Details
- Source System: {SOURCE}
- Target Environment: {ENV}
- Medallion Architecture: Bronze → Silver → Gold
acceptance_criteria: Ingestion design document is created and reviewed
Data profiling results are documented with sample data analysis
Ingestion pattern (full/incremental/CDC) is determined and documented
Data lineage mapping is completed from source to target
Technical specifications for data types and transformations are defined
Error handling and retry strategies are documented
Performance requirements and benchmarks are established

step_2_platform_setup.title: Platform Setup/Sprint Zero - Infrastructure and repository setup

tickets.title: [{SOURCE}] Platform Setup - Infrastructure & Repository Configuration
tickets.description:
As a Data Engineer, I need to set up all required infrastructure components for {SOURCE} integration including storage, repository, secrets, and network configuration.

## Overview
This ticket covers the complete platform setup (Sprint Zero) for {SOURCE}, ensuring all infrastructure components are provisioned and configured correctly.

## Scope
1. **Bucket Creation**: Create and configure storage buckets/containers for data landing
2. **Dataset Creation**: Set up datasets/schemas in the target data platform
3. **GitHub Repository Creation**: Create and configure repository with proper branching strategy
4. **Secrets Creation**: Set up Key Vault/Secrets Manager with required credentials
5. **Acquire Credentials**: Obtain and securely store source system credentials
6. **Firewall Rules**: Configure network security rules for source connectivity
7. **Source Connectivity**: Validate end-to-end connectivity to source system

## Technical Details
- Source System: {SOURCE}
- Target Environment: {ENV}
- Infrastructure: Azure/Databricks/Lakehouse
acceptance_criteria: Storage bucket/container is created with proper naming convention and access policies
Dataset/schema is created in Dev Landing lakehouse with appropriate permissions
GitHub repository is created with main, develop, and feature branch structure
Branch policies and PR requirements are configured
CI/CD pipeline templates are set up in the repository
All required secrets are stored in Key Vault with proper access policies
Source system credentials are obtained and securely stored
Firewall rules are configured and documented
Network connectivity test to source system is successful
Service principal/managed identity has required permissions
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates are committed to repository
README.md with setup instructions is created
